public_rationale: The evidence points toward continued reliability problems: a December research-agent study found substantial failures, and a production survey reported reliability as the leading challenge. Google also documented real research gains from AlphaEvolve. These records do not establish whether a leading internal agent met both parts of the claim at year-end. Scoring the whole forecast would require extrapolating beyond the evaluated systems and supplying a consequential threshold for reliability.
limitations: One observed outcome cannot establish whether an unspecified probability was well calibrated.
Specialized benchmark failures do not rule out dependable assistance on other research tasks.

statement.excerpt: But will they be “great” at that by the end of the year? And will they have resolved the tendency towards errors that the stumbling prototype agents of mid-2025 had made? That much progress in 6 months would truly be phenomenal. But I seriously doubt it.
statement.document_title: The “AI 2027” Scenario: How realistic is it?

from_speaker: by the end of the year
our_interpretation: The claim doubts a joint achievement: strong assistance with AI research and dependable execution without the recurring material errors associated with prototype agents.

Resolved error tendencies means practical reliability, not literal infallibility. Great assistance means substantial, repeatable contributions to research, not necessarily independent replacement of researchers.
The expression of doubt is not an antecedent. This assessment concerns the predicted outcome, not the calibration of an unspecified probability.
The reference to internal development means public products alone cannot exhaust the relevant systems.
criteria.support_condition: Representative evidence about leading research agents at the deadline establishes that the joint achievement had not occurred, particularly because material execution errors remained.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Dated evidence establishes that at least one leading agent available internally or externally by the deadline repeatedly made substantial AI-research contributions with dependable execution.
